title: Noninvasive investigation of the cardiodynamic response to 6MWT in stroke patients
author: Alice YM YM YM Jones
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6s2hege

steps.title: Collect Participant Data
steps.instruction: Record demographic and medical history for each participant.

substeps.instruction: Record age, gender, height, weight, body mass index, and lean body mass.
Record time elapsed since stroke diagnosis, medical history, National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS), and Modified Rivermead Mobility Index (MRMI) from medical records.

steps.title: Prepare Skin for Impedance Cardiography
steps.instruction: Lower skin resistance over the neck and thorax region using NuPrep gel and 70% isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Place Impedance Cardiography Electrodes
steps.instruction: Apply pregelled Ag/AgCl electrodes (Skintact model FS-TB wet-gel; Leonhard Lang Gmbh, Austria) to specific anatomical locations.

substeps.instruction: Place electrodes on the left base of the neck above the supraclavicular fossa.
Place electrodes at the sternal angle.
Place electrodes at the V6 position.
Place electrodes along the left paraspinal region at the xiphoid level.

steps.title: Connect and Secure Monitoring Device
steps.instruction: Connect electrodes to the PhysioFlow® PF07 Enduro™ device and place the device in a belt pouch to maintain stability during walking.

steps.title: Establish Baseline Measurements
steps.instruction: Have the participant rest in a sitting position for 10 minutes to measure baseline parameters.

steps.title: Perform 6-Minute Walk Test (6MWT)
steps.instruction: Conduct the 6MWT following the American Thoracic Society Guideline on 2 consecutive days while monitoring cardiodynamic variables and oxygen saturation.

substeps.instruction: Collect heart rate (HR), stroke volume (SV), cardiac output (CO), and cardiac index (CI) data every second via the Enduro™ device.
Measure oxygen saturation (Heal Force pulse oximeter, POD-3, China) immediately before the 6MWT, at each minute during the test, and at the end of the test.

steps.title: Perform Post-Walk Measurements
steps.instruction: Measure blood pressure and continue cardiodynamic monitoring after the 6MWT.

substeps.instruction: Measure blood pressure (OMRON electronic blood pressure monitor, U30, China) immediately after the 6MWT and at 2-minute intervals thereafter.
Continue collecting cardiodynamic data for 10 minutes after the 6MWT.

steps.title: Analyze Collected Data
steps.instruction: Process the recorded data using IBM SPSS Statistics for Windows, Version 23.0.

substeps.instruction: Average HR, SV, CO, and CI data every 10 seconds.
Analyze data at rest, at every 30th second during the 6MWT, and at every 30th second for 10 minutes after the 6MWT.
